scoring: Two metrics, fixed before any candidate output. (1) PREFIX agreement, all scored points: the candidate's first segment (its actions up to and including its first chance action: a draw, search, coin or random pick, incl. UseStadium on Mesagoza; or its whole turn if none) is correct if it matches answer.first_segment or the first_segment of an acceptable line. (2) PLAN-SEGMENT agreement: the same test on the points whose answer.segment_scope is 'full' (the scored segment holds all of his turn's strategic actions). The two are reported separately; prefix agreement is not a measure of plan quality. Matching is by REPLAY: apply the candidate's segment and each accepted segment to the position and compare the resulting state up to the chance boundary (board, hand, discard, Energy, Tools, points, Active), so a retreat that renumbers slots is judged by its result, not its labels; label-set matching is only a fallback when replay is unavailable and must be reported as such. All 51 points are scored (Dustin answered the 5 pending points on Oct 19; see key_rule). Points with decided_game true are also reported separately. Points carry their game id: results use a game-level bootstrap, paired across candidates; an unclear difference is 'inconclusive'. Reported per deck kind and answer kind, always with 'three decks only'.

label_format: Answer key and legal_root use the AI judge's target-preserving labels: plain labels as before, and actions with arguments as Name#{json} with sorted keys (e.g. a Field Blower Tool discard keeps player, Pokemon and Tool index). build/label_adapter.py converts to and from the legal-moves tool's Name{k:v} form losslessly; compare with same_action() (parsed arguments), never by name alone. answer.legal_steps keeps the tool's raw form.
scope_rule: A point's segment_scope is set by its shortest accepted segment (coordinator, Oct 19): 'full' only if every accepted line's first segment (his and each acceptable line; pending alternatives don't count) contains all of that line's strategic actions; 'none' if his own first segment contains none of his strategic actions; otherwise 'partial'. Plan-segment agreement uses 'full' points only; 'partial' and 'none' points count for prefix agreement only. segment_scope_by_line and segment_scope_his show the parts; segment_scope_v13 keeps the old value.
key_rule: The answer key is what a good player of his decks would do, using his judgment.
